items.question: How many private and public hospitals in Dubai can international medical tourists book procedure packages at through the Dubai Health Experience portal?
items.gold: 26 private and public hospitals in Dubai.
items.fact: Dubai Health Experience portal covers 26 Dubai hospitals for medical tourists.

items.question: Which government medical complexes in the UAE offer a variety of medical and cosmetic facilities?
items.gold: Dubai Healthcare City, Sheikh Khalifa Medical City, Sheikh Shakhbout Medical City (SSMC) and Sharjah Healthcare City.
items.fact: Four government medical complexes offer medical and cosmetic facilities in the UAE.
